# Synthetic Milestone 2B Fixtures

These fixtures are deterministic, synthetic, license-safe contract probes. They
contain no participant-derived signals, checkpoints, model weights, or source
result payloads.

The raw logs have four synthetic subjects, 24 rows, and 120 tab-separated
columns. Values are generated by the formula in raw/compact_rows.json. The
two-row label-99 gap in subject 01 exercises filter-before-runs bridging.
Compact windows use four samples and stride two; production metadata remains
160/40 at 50 Hz. The safe compact counts are subject 01: 7 and subjects 02,
03, and 05: 8.

Run the public tests from the repository root. SHA256SUMS covers every fixture
file except itself, uses sorted POSIX-relative paths, and hashes UTF-8 text after
normalizing CRLF to LF so Windows checkout settings cannot change fixture identity.
